meaning: Exhaustiveness of the grammar-fixing cases from excluded middle alone (owner decision 2026-11-06, #1010; same form as POTENCY-ANALYSIS-PARTITION): every practice's grammar is fixed by its authorities, or not and by ordinary use, or by neither. No list of theories of grammar enters; cellsExclusive shows the cells are disjoint. It establishes the partition, not which cell the Catholic practice is in.
